newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse slips 0.21 percent at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse slips 0.21 percent at mid-session.

text.p: Greek stocks recovered earlier losses but were still trading 0.21 percent lower around mid-session and market watchers called the correction normal and expected.
"The correction was normal and we were expecting it," said Pavlos Vranas, managing director at Euroxx Securities.
The Athens general share index was trading down 0.21 percent or 2.22 points at 1067.79 in mid-session after opening at 1074.23.

Most sectoral indices were down with investment shares 0.02 percent lower, construction slipping 1.60 percent and only banks gaining 0.50 percent. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
